# Levi's Houston Structural Repairs, Engineering & Consulting

> Licensed structural engineering and construction firm in Houston, Texas. One firm designs the structure and builds it: room additions, second story additions, load-bearing wall removal with steel beams, and structural repairs across the Houston metro. Phone (713) 992-5454. Open Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 8 PM.

## Services
- [Second story additions](https://houstonstructure.com/services/second-story-addition): checking what the existing house can carry, then designing and building the new floor
- [Home and room additions](https://houstonstructure.com/services/home-additions): new rooms tied into the existing foundation
- [Load-bearing wall removal](https://houstonstructure.com/services/load-bearing-wall-removal): engineering the beam, posts and footings before the wall comes out
- [Steel beam installation](https://houstonstructure.com/services/steel-beam-installation)
- [Structural repairs](https://houstonstructure.com/services/structural-repairs)
- [Kitchen design and remodeling](https://houstonstructure.com/services/kitchen-remodeling)
- [All services](https://houstonstructure.com/services)

## Service areas
Houston and the surrounding metro, including the Memorial Villages (Spring Valley Village, Piney Point Village, Bunker Hill Village, Hedwig Village, Hilshire Village, Hunters Creek Village), Bellaire, West University Place, Houston Heights, The Woodlands, Katy, Cypress, Pearland, Missouri City, Sugar Land and Fort Bend County.
